These are original, redistributable synthetic examples authored for QuixiChat. They contain no personal history and are not files captured from an actual provider account. They may be reused under the repository's license. No upstream fixture or adapter code was copied.

The ChatGPT fixture models an observed `conversations.json` mapping with provider-native message IDs, parent links, alternate answers, text, and attachment metadata. OpenAI currently documents [ZIP export](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/7260999-how-do-i-export-my-chatgpt-history-and-data), including [conversation JSON and numbered files for larger exports](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9106926-transferring-conversations-from-1-chatgpt-account-to-another-chatgpt-account). Its complete consumer-export field schema is not published there.

The Claude fixture models an observed consumer `chat_messages` array with UUIDs, sender, text/content, attachment metadata and explicit parent UUIDs. Anthropic documents [consumer export availability](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9450526-export-your-claude-data), without specifying a complete consumer-export field schema. This profile is separate from the Claude Compliance API fixture in the canonical contract tests.

Field-shape observations were checked against the primary maintainer's [our-dialogues compatibility documentation and synthetic fixtures, pinned at f3bed09f67ab91bfa466737923d7828b839a95fb](https://github.com/willwefind/our-dialogues/tree/f3bed09f67ab91bfa466737923d7828b839a95fb). That maintainer reports testing actual 2026 exports, but its published fixtures are synthetic. This is independent format evidence, not proof that QuixiChat has tested an actual current provider export. The upstream implementation is AGPL; these QuixiChat examples and parsers were independently written from observed data fields.

The `unknown_widget`/`unknown_block` values and all dialogue, IDs, file names and metadata are invented. Missing attachment bytes are intentional. These examples test retention behavior and supported shapes; they do not close plan 04's real official-export capture acceptance gate. Source observations were reviewed on 2026-09-08.
